result.topic_en: Algebraic manipulation of a pair of linear equations in t and u, built from a binary quadratic form with coefficients a, b, c and linear terms d, e, deriving an expression for z = u/(t+1) as a quotient of determinant-like expressions.
result.transcription:
[-$f = u$-]
$z = \frac{1}{f}$
$f = \frac{t+1}{u}$
$z = \frac{u}{t+1}$

$t\mathfrak{M} + u(b\mathfrak{M} + c\mathfrak{N}) = m$
$t\mathfrak{N} - u(a\mathfrak{M} + b\mathfrak{N}) = n$

$\mathfrak{D}\mathfrak{D}(\upsilon x - y\xi)$
$+ \mathfrak{D}\upsilon g - \mathfrak{D}\xi h$
$+ h\mathfrak{D}x$

$\mathfrak{D}\upsilon m + hm$
$- \mathfrak{D}\xi n - gn$

$x = \frac{m + cd - be}{\mathfrak{D}}$
$y = \frac{n + ae - bd}{\mathfrak{D}}$
$\xi = \frac{\mathfrak{M} + cd - be}{\mathfrak{D}}$
$\upsilon = \frac{\mathfrak{N} + ae - bd}{\mathfrak{D}}$

$bde - cdd$
$bde - aee$

$m = \mathfrak{D}x + g$
$n = \mathfrak{D}y + h$
$\mathfrak{M} = \mathfrak{D}\xi + g$
$\mathfrak{N} = \mathfrak{D}\upsilon + h$

$\mathfrak{D}\mathfrak{D}x\upsilon + \mathfrak{D}(g\upsilon + xh) + yh$[?]
$y\xi$

$dg + eh$

$z =$
$(t+1)\mathfrak{M} + u(b\mathfrak{M} + c\mathfrak{N}) = m + \mathfrak{M}$
$(t+1)\mathfrak{N} - u(a\mathfrak{M} + b\mathfrak{N}) = n + \mathfrak{N}$

$(t+1)(\mathfrak{M}n - \mathfrak{N}m) + u\left(\begin{matrix} b\mathfrak{M}n + c\mathfrak{N}n \\ + a\mathfrak{M}m + b\mathfrak{N}m \end{matrix} + a\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{M} + 2b\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{N} + c\mathfrak{N}\mathfrak{N}\right)$

$z = \frac{\mathfrak{N}m - \mathfrak{M}n}{a\mathfrak{M}m + b(\mathfrak{M}n + \mathfrak{N}m) + c\mathfrak{N}n + a\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{M} + 2b\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{N} + c\mathfrak{N}\mathfrak{N}}$

Numerator = $\mathfrak{D}\mathfrak{D}(x\upsilon - y\xi)$
Denominator = $a\mathfrak{M} + b\mathfrak{N} = \mathfrak{D}(a\xi + b\upsilon + d)$
$b\mathfrak{M} + c\mathfrak{N} = \mathfrak{D}(b\xi + c\upsilon + e)$

$z = \frac{\mathfrak{D}(x\upsilon - y\xi)}{(m+\mathfrak{M})(a\xi + b\upsilon + d) + (n+\mathfrak{N})(b\xi + c\upsilon + e)}$

Denom. = $m(a\xi + b\upsilon + d) + n(b\xi + c\upsilon + e)$
$+ \mathfrak{D}(a\xi\xi + 2b\xi\upsilon + c\upsilon\upsilon + 2d\xi + 2e\upsilon) - (aee$ [ink blot] $cdd)$
$+ \mathfrak{D}\xi(ax + by + d) + \mathfrak{D}\upsilon(bx + cy + e)$
$+ \mathfrak{D}(dx + ey)$

methods.what: Substitution relating z, f, t, u
Linear system in t, u built from the coefficients of a quadratic form
Change of variables shifting by the centre of a quadratic form with linear terms d, e
Elimination giving z as a ratio of a determinant to a quadratic-form expression
Expression of the linear forms in the new variables
Final simplified formula for z in the transformed variables

methods.quote: Denom. = $m(a\xi + b\upsilon + d) + n(b\xi + c\upsilon + e)$
